capstones.objective: Design and simulate a low-cost, lawful search-and-rescue drone under endurance, payload, weather, privacy, reliability and unit-cost constraints.
Design a measured precision-farming system that improves resource use without overstating biological outcomes.
Optimise a safe microgrid across generation, storage, demand, reliability, emissions and lifetime cost.
Improve a small factory using sensing, quality control, automation, maintenance and unit economics.
Build a governed business operating system that converts verified evidence into useful, approval-gated departmental work.
Design a monitored water-conservation and failure-response plan for a resource-constrained community.
Research, paper-trade and govern a multi-strategy quantitative portfolio under realistic costs, capacity, liquidity, model-risk, compliance and drawdown constraints.

Map an industry, identify lawful bottlenecks and dependencies, rank build-buy-partner options, and propose a resilient strategic-asset portfolio without moving capital or exercising external authority.

Assess an explicitly owned isolated network and application range, demonstrate bounded weaknesses, detect the activity, repair every validated defect and independently prove the repaired range resists the same and variant attacks.

Continuously ingest real public prediction markets, research resolvable events, commit calibrated probabilities before outcomes, paper-trade under realistic fees and liquidity, learn from delayed settlement, and only after independent evidence propose tightly bounded owner-approved live orders and compliant market suggestions.

governance.claim_boundary: curriculum membership, reading and practice never constitute expertise
governance.dual_use_restrictions: permit benign, defensive, safety, resilience and compliance work; block weapon construction, targeting and harmful operational enablement
governance.high_stakes_escalation: medical, legal and financial actions require current authoritative sources and qualified human authority
governance.physical_execution: requires authorised hardware, sandbox, safety case and human approval

knowledge_graph.unknown_policy: unknowns and contradictions remain first-class nodes rather than being silently completed
